system.description:
With deepening mastery, the countermage meets a rival's blood magic with overwhelming force of will.

Using Countermagic is a free action. Make a Mental Challenge against the caster with four extra Traits; on a win the opposed Thaumaturgy power or ritual fails. As at the previous level, you may counter magic affecting anyone or anything in physical contact with you. Your Countermagic rating must equal or exceed the rating of the power opposed, it works at full strength only against Tremere Thaumaturgy, and it is weakened by four Traits against other blood magic and hedge magic.
